theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (m k : ℕ) (G c : Rn n → (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k)) (A R α : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 < R → 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → Measurable G → (∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) (R / 4), ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ R / 4 → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z (s / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (G x - c z)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A * s ^ n * (s / R) ^ (2 * α))) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R / 16), ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R / 16), hsNorm (c x - c y) ≤ C * Real.sqrt A * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α
